name: context_read
description: Read missing detail: context=PUBLIC situation, character=full self, items=ranked item search (normalized names/IDs, word fragments, typos, Chinese overlap, rule text; offset/limit), scene=current entry prose, supplies=recorded local stock. Matches disclose kind/evidence/rulesId, not scene presence or permission. Never invent an object from a search result; use established current evidence. Empty means unknown, not absent. scope=context, scene or character accepts no nonempty query or pagination. query/offset/limit filter items (and pagination for supplies), not the situation. Current DM-only evidence is already in workingContext; this tool does not search private threats. Invalid arguments save nothing: correct them in a new call.

name: actions_list
description: Optional current action list. execution_state already supplies candidates and exact source, target and cost.

name: actions_propose
description: Submit one current candidateId only for the player's requested full labeled action and scope; NPC/topic overlap is not enough. Ordinary/identity conversation uses world_record. Returns a result or waits for separate mechanical consent. Ordinary observation/conversation is not approach, search or quest acceptance. Prefer matching executable authored actions over human rulings; a candidate's existence alone does not select it. Actual NPC hostilities use the offered combat.start entry without selecting a player attack.

name: checks_result
description: Read this action's authoritative roll receipts; read-only.

name: world_record
description: Commit this input's established narrative directly; complete defaults true and stops even if narrative is empty, complete=false continues. Public narrative (or exclusive paragraphs) may be empty; privateMessages are optional, never manufacture either audience or announce a secret was sent. Each message has actual recipientIds (one or several approved seats, independently of the actor), second-person text, and optional exact discoveryIds. Shared visible phenomena remain third-person public; only actual personal recognition, perception, private conversation or experience belongs in private messages. Profession alone does not establish knowledge. Undiscovered traps/enemies/host plans/future plot go to NO player. Failed searches never confirm hidden identity/existence. discoveryIds must already be KnownTo EVERY recipient; only those pending entities become presented. Ordinary private speech and public retellings grant no map location or unrelated findings. Private text is STORY ONLY, no dice/DC/modifiers, result labels, tools, waits or receipts. Do not invent actions, motives, agreements or accepted quests. Check every clause of the real input, execute actual movement and mechanics first, never reroll a saved check. Optional public memory (max6) updates only actually supplied current public IDs with matching kind; new id is empty, sceneId is known or empty. New NPCs use saved individual names. No private content in memory/continuity. Items/supplies require actual current sourced acquisition/permission and remaining stock, not promises or historical backfill; use catalog IDs and exact supplied evidence, never invent rules or grant twice. No HP, facts, rewards, routes or discovery changes from prose. Nonempty legacy private and messages cannot be mixed.

id.description: For a NEW object send the empty string (id: ""); the server assigns its ID. Never invent an ID. To UPDATE, use an actual public object ID returned by execution_state, context_read or world_search at the current version.

private.description: Legacy actor-only text. Prefer privateMessages; nonempty legacy private cannot be combined with messages. Empty legacy private is ignored.

itemId.description: Exact ID from current inventory or context_read scope=items; empty for a non-mechanical custom prop.

detail.description: Exact quote from pre-existing imported current scene summary/arrival or an offered local public preparation/dm record. Must support this item, quantity and permission. Your narrative, model records, catalog hits and this call cannot establish presence. For an existing supply claim, describe the actual receipt; its original source is also checked.

complete.description: Default true ends this action with the saved narrative. False is an intermediate record.

text.description: Short public continuity note; preserve speaker, uncertainty and negation. Model notes are not mechanical truth. No decorative gestures or private knowledge.

id.description: Empty creates; supplied ID updates. Same source/item cannot be recreated to refill stock.

quantity.description: Established total stock, including already claimed units; never reset to remaining.

unit.description: One catalog inventory unit, e.g. one rope or flask; no inferred lengths or conversions.

detail.description: Exact quote from pre-existing imported current scene summary/arrival or an offered local public preparation/dm record. Must support this item, quantity and permission. Your narrative, model records, catalog hits and this call cannot establish presence.

name: ask_player
description: Pause to ask for missing intent or information. The answer is not mechanical consent.

name: ruling_request
description: Pause for a specific unresolved mechanical ruling. State the missing basis and any existing roll/result. The question is host-only; public waiting text is server-generated. This call executes no check or combat.

name: skills_list
description: List this run's explicitly imported read-only methods.

name: skills_read
description: Read an imported method by id; reference data only.

name: rules_scope
description: Read local rule availability and execution limits. Reference text never executes mechanics. Prefer ordinary non-mechanical narrative or a matching offered action; missing intent uses ask_player. Only actual unsupported mechanical events or concrete corrections need human judgement. Encounter guidance is conditional capability information, not a command to start combat or request a ruling.

name: memory_search
description: Search this seat's completed public actions by all query words. nextBefore pages older results; memory_read gives detail.

name: memory_read
description: Read one own completed public action and original results. Historical evidence is not current execution authority. Read supplied context first; query only missing evidence.

name: world_search
description: Search shared PUBLIC objects. Returned ids may be updated at the current execution version. nextOffset pages the same query/kind. Coverage is indexed PUBLIC records only; no match means unknown in this search, not absent from the world. Read supplied context first; query only missing evidence.

name: rules_search
description: Search pinned local Chinese rules. Results are previews; nextOffset pages the same query/category.

name: rules_read
description: Read a pinned rule by id. Follow nextOffset to null for complete text; reference text does not execute mechanics.

name: memory_semantic_search
description: Find own public history with local concept/lexical matching. Source-linked extracts; memory_read gives full evidence.

name: memory_digest
description: Read source-linked extracts of own public history. nextBefore pages older entries.

name: world_routes
description: Read current legal authored exits AND public dynamic routes. source distinguishes them; canTravel is outbound from the current scene. Only editable dynamic rows have a route id for world_route_propose. Locked authored exits are not revealed. Read-only: a known entrance, a known destination, completed travel and resolved hazards are different facts.

name: world_route_propose
description: Propose a route for separate player confirmation, not travel. Use a supplied scene/place and an established travel time; ask_player if unknown.

name: map_request
description: Request a PLAYER map for the CURRENT public scene and explicit purpose (region, settlement, tactical, schematic). Purpose never determines physical scale. First reuse a suitable published map in board.maps with map_select; a ready town/region map does NOT block a needed local tactical map. Server deduplicates one automatic slot per scene+purpose, automatically generates/publishes it, and never retries pending/failed/withheld slots just because you call again. Do not poll through tool calls. For tactical only, optional tacticalScale.longEdgeFeet is the DM-adopted physical extent of the complete output canvas's LONGEST edge (10..160 feet; default120, matching the engine's two-unit minimum and 32-cell maximum); the shorter edge is proportional, and actual output dimensions determine the saved feet/pixel. This is a local schematic DM setting, never recovered source geography or inherited image/style scale. No arbitrary prompt, private prose or reference. Completed generation does NOT select the map or move any entity: map_select explicitly, then place the same existing instances with grounded new-map positions.

name: map_state_read
description: Read the current scene's published player board, exact spawn sources and latest operations. The parent automatically attaches same-version overview/detail images before every model call. No GM maps or hidden units. Viewing maps never changes sceneId; use offered travel/scene actions. frame.board.maps lists current-scene published player maps with their independent purpose, scale and basis; frame.board.state.map and its images are the actual frozen selection. This read returns the selection as board.map and candidates as top-level maps. Use map_select to change the shared selected map, never infer another map's scale or coordinates.

name: token_read
description: Read this current visible instance's actual details (unknown fields stay unknown), not a template or an action. Does not move, converse, spend resources or grant control.

name: token_spawn
description: Place actual approved party characters or supplied public sources on the current map. The DM chooses initial positions from scene/image evidence; never ask players to place themselves or approve coordinates. Player source.id and actorId use the supplied party actor ID, not Character ID; existingId is empty for a new binding. Existing instances retain their identity and state. Multiple party placements execute directly without player confirmation. Cannot bypass movement restrictions, active combat, map version or source validation; no invented stats or discoveries. Name each new non-player creature before story delivery: use an individual Chinese name or fitting nickname, not a type/serial label. Named authored NPC sources and validated build identities retain their names; player/object/existing instances are not automatically renamed. A finite set of generic labels receives an original fallback without combat dice or another model request. Read and reuse the actual saved names from the returned board/token, including fallback names. Equal names never identify the same person: use entity IDs. Do not infer culture, gender or history from an icon or creature type. Cross-map placement reuses source.kind=existing plus the exact existingId and explicit NEW coordinates on the selected map; prior-map positions and all state are retained. Never copy normalized old-map coordinates or create a second player/NPC instance.

existingId.description: Use empty string for a new player/npc/enemy/custom instance. ONLY reuse an exact entity id from board.state.tokens or an existing spawn source. A self.id/Character id is NOT a Board entity id.

id.description: Exact id from board.sources for the chosen kind. player uses self.actorId, NOT self.id. existing uses a supplied Board entity id.

name: token_move
description: Move an actual visible token on the current map using normalized image coordinates and optional path/snap. DM movement of players executes without a location-approval dialog, including other approved party members in exploration. Preserve actual movement restrictions; in combat only the current actor can use the existing turn/budget/opportunity/reaction engine. No teleportation through combat rules, consent to dice, or invented arrival before the receipt.

name: token_update
description: Update only public name/description/icon on an authorized unit. Never HP, AC, abilities, conditions, inventory, resources or source/template bindings. Appearance has no rule effects; iconKey uses a registered local appearance: goblin, wolf, skeleton, zombie, spider, bear, boar, npc, chest (or empty fallback). Not a URL or secret identity; appearance never implies rules. Reuse the actual saved individual name; do not replace it with a generic type/number or invent a second story name. Use this existing explicit update only for a grounded appearance/name correction. A non-player name change also updates its matching active combat unit in the same transaction, never historical text. Player names remain authoritative character names. entityId, not a shared name, selects the person.

name: token_remove
description: Remove an actual visible instance from the current exploration map without deleting its identity or statistics. DM position changes need no player approval; active-combat departure must use combat rules, never this tool.

name: check_request
description: Request the current actor's real out-of-combat check; active checks await own consent, passive is only Wisdom/Perception. For concealed runtime enemies set encounterId from encounter_read/prepare, wisdom/Perception, and the setup's exact sourceId/quote; OMIT dc. Server compares the saved NPC Stealth results, records personal discoveries and never rerolls NPCs. Then encounter_read returns the private outcome. Otherwise dc must be explicitly in current source, or omit only for a genuinely useful unopposed number. No rerolls of this run's failed/cancelled task. This does not start combat or grant shared knowledge. New personal discoveries are mechanically saved immediately but stay off the player map until story delivery. After a resolved opposed check, read encounter_read and deliver this actor's found entities in private story before further action; do not repeat the check. For v43 story delivery use privateMessages with the exact actual recipientIds and discoveryIds, not legacy private; no arbitrary private chat releases discoveries. A failure must not confirm an undiscovered entity's existence or identity.

dc.description: Optional existing DC explicitly written as DC N in the cited source. Omit only for a genuinely unopposed number; missing opposition should be ruled before requesting dice.

name: encounter_read
description: Read current DM-only runtime encounter, actual roster/positions, saved NPC Hide dice, personal discoveries and verified 2024 profiles. Call to obtain available exact profiles before initial setup or to inspect a settled search. Never expose hidden roster/dice/positions in public text or memory. Read-only; does not initialize, roll, reveal or begin combat. observations.unpresentedIds are established discoveries still owed to their actor as story, including a prior interrupted input. They are DM evidence, not yet player-visible tokens. Do not narrate another actor's private findings publicly. Deliver only explicitly named already-known discoveryIds to their actual recipientIds through privateMessages. A shared retelling does not grant exact entity locations or release other pending findings.

name: encounter_prepare
description: Prepare ONE current-scene encounter from supplied non-model evidence and verified profile IDs. Does not start combat. Uses ONLY the selected map's actual saved reliable scale and explicit tactical purpose. The server derives 5-foot logic cells without changing any physical length; there are NO pixel/grid arguments. Region, settlement, unknown-purpose or uncalibrated maps cannot be reinterpreted as 5 feet. Reuse a suitable current-scene local map with map_select; otherwise map_request purpose=tactical and wait for its one automatic lifecycle. After selecting a different map, explicitly place the SAME existing entities there with grounded new coordinates, retaining their old-map positions and HP/resources; never copy normalized positions. layoutReason explains the grounded placement/terrain, not a replacement scale. terrain explicitly binds up to 35 grid cells; no terrain is inferred from art. Each enemy has a unique normalized position and supported tactic. Hiding requires three-quarters-cover or total-cover cells between it and all party members plus hidingReason confirming out-of-sight circumstances; server rolls its real DC15 Stealth once. Hidden instances/rolls stay private. No darkness/3D simulation, fake DC, self-reported stats, resets or cloning. Use the returned encounterId for a Perception check when relevant, then encounter_engage only if hostilities actually begin. Give EVERY enemy an individual Chinese name or nickname BEFORE describing it in story. XDMG Name permits adapted/original names; match only established setting/tone, never invent ancestry, gender or an undead creature's former life. Retain supplied proper names. Bare template/type labels and their numbers receive a small original server fallback, not an official translated book name. Reuse the returned saved roster names in all later tools and story; never invent another name while narrating. Hidden names/roster remain private until actually discovered.

name: encounter_engage
description: Begin actual hostilities for the saved runtime encounter; reason is a private DM decision, not player consent. Server opens the existing per-player initiative consent group; no initiative/attack/damage before everyone confirms. surprisedActors lists only genuinely unaware party actors supported by still-hidden NPC records; discovered enemies preclude ambush surprise. 2024 surprise is initiative disadvantage, never a skipped round. NPC attacks and damage then use the existing persistent 2024 engine, including Shield/death waits. Do not use this for mere threats, a search alone or to bypass an unresolved ruling.

name: combat_delegate
description: Delegate the entire actual hostile encounter BEFORE initiative to its independent persistent combat agent. Exploration then suspends. Use the existing encounterId; reason and continuity preserve motives, relationships, exact statements and the interrupted intent as attributed interpretation, not rule facts. Do not delegate mere threats/discovery or rerun settled setup. The child directly handles later inputs, negotiations, rolls and reactions until authoritative battle closure. A complete world_record ends one input, never the battle. If an authoritative battle already exists without a combat agent, this adopts that SAME battle at its current turn; it never rebuilds units, rolls initiative again or resets resources. Pending player confirmations must be settled first.

name: combat_history_read
description: Read source-addressed battle history, not another mode's raw transcript. A combat child may read only its own session; exploration may recall completed sessions this actor participated in. scope=sessions (omit sessionId) lists authorized completed IDs; agent.recentCombatSessions lists recent ones. events reads original public outcomes and only this actor's private discoveries; discoveries selects only own private discoveries without paging through public mechanics; inputs reads own questions/answers and accepted narrative notes, never a peer journal; units reads frozen final results for the original parent; people and corrections read CURRENT authorized profiles/corrections and are not frozen by through. For events/inputs keep through and follow nextAfter to retrieve more relevant detail; pages do not require reading the whole battle before every action. through=0 selects current/end. Text parts preserve sourceId and character offset Part; concatenate exactly. Original narrative can be superseded by current corrections. Audience=actor stays private; attributed notes and answers never establish mechanical facts. No execution or provider calls.

name: opening_commit
description: Save this entry once. public may be empty; if opening.writePublic=false it must be empty. Optional privateMessages target actual established knowers, not necessarily the entering actor, with shared experiences sent to several recipients. No addition means omit it; no invented secret or public hint of private delivery. Only established backstory/relationships/messages, no discoveryIds or future/host secrets. Third-person public and second-person private STORY ONLY; no mechanics/receipts. Preserve real positions; if a supplied board lacks this actor, first token_spawn once at a grounded DM-chosen position. No accepted quests, invented actions, time, inventory or memories. Stops even when both audiences are empty.

private.description: Legacy actor-only text. Prefer privateMessages; nonempty legacy private cannot be combined with messages. Empty legacy private is ignored.

name: story_shared_read
description: Read public player statements, including publication=retelling. Text is exactly what that actor chose to say, NOT the entire private source; keep attribution, uncertainty and negation. A statement does not grant mechanical truth, discovery or precise location. after=0 starts oldest; follow nextAfter. No unpublished sources or private action audit.

name: map_select
description: Select ONE supplied current-scene published PLAYER map by its exact id and map version. Persists a shared scene selection in the campaign transaction; no token movement, new instance, travel or scale change. An active combat's frozen map takes precedence and cannot be switched away. The next model slot supplies the newly selected same-version image and metadata: inspect it before any positional write; old image/coordinates authorize nothing on the new map.
